title: Nourishing Molten Korean Blackberries Namul
description: A herbal and molten one-pot Korean dish featuring blackberries, this namul is a unique and nourishing treat. It combines the flavors of Busan with the principles of ayurvedic tamasic-friendly cooking.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, puree the blackberries until smooth.
In a small saucepan, combine the soy sauce, rice vinegar, and honey, and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the sauce for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the sesame oil, garlic, and ginger.
Add the blackberry puree, toasted sesame seeds, and brine to the bowl, and stir to combine.
Pour the sauce into the bowl and stir until the mixture is well combined.
Transfer the mixture to 4 ramekins and place them on a baking sheet.
Bake the namul for 15 minutes, or until it is warm and molten.
Remove the namul from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
